# SI044 — admin-override-present

There is no admin override.

## Why

An operator who can change verdicts or the allowlist destroys neutrality and the public-record guarantee.

## Bad

```python
def admin_set_verdict(self, incident_id, verdict): ...
```

## Good

```python
def get_verdict(self, incident_id: str) -> str: ...
```

## Suppression

```python
# safetynet-disable-next-line SI044 -- reason
```
